active.notes: Effective Zone data preserves previously locked v0.4.1 affinities; unmodified Book1 values live under raw.zone_selection and raw.book1_original.

rules.status: Selection v0.4.2 LOCKED; City v0.4.3 APPROVED EXPERIMENT; Location Placement PENDING
rules.source_priority: Book1 ORIGINAL > overlays explicitly approved in discussions > effective generator. Never use pre-v0.4 versions to overwrite Book1.

faction.constraints: F1 Government, F2 Revolutionary. Government excludes Elite/Poor/Revolutionary/Outsider. Elite and Poor separate. F7 discarded before naming. Unique Base/Animal across six.
faction.naming_grammar: Base-specific M/O/P/S grammar weights from Book1

zone.Function_penalty: -SOFT(affinities >=75 for at-or-over max) - SOFT(affinities >=75 for over-max)
zone.Function_coverage: increment all Functions with affinity>=75 after each selection
zone.modifier_scope: both Faction and supplemental Zone selection

location.unique: one instance max of each Location type
location.zone_stage: each Zone chooses one unused Location: Place affinity + Random[0,100]*0.20 + Location modifier
location.faction_stage: six Factions choose one unused Location each: AVG(Type1,Type2,Base)+CUBERT(Type1*Type2*Base)+Random[0,100]*0.60+modifier
location.supplemental: Random[0,100]+Function modifier+R1*AVG(existing Location fit, Zone fit)+R2*average existing Faction fit+modifier
location.SOFT: same SOFT and Function modifier as Zone, but Location-specific quotas
location.distribution_target: <=60% soft across worlds; 60.667% Hideout in heldout

city.version: v0.4.3 approved experiment, no web deployment
city.fallback_0_outside: exactly 1 flexible Zone with smallest Inside City score; random ties
city.emergency_if_more_than_3: randomly convert strict Outside into Inside until 3 outside remain
city.standalone_location_city: 0 Outside, 4 Inside, 1=30%, 2=60%, 3=90% Inside after matching; not implemented

placement.matching: two directional relative preferences + Faction alignment discussed, not implemented
placement.standalone_location: allowed, city status determined after Zone matching

meta.master_role: one source-of-truth snapshot: Book1 preserved in raw.book1_original, approved overlays, active effective Zone snapshot and simulation rules
meta.zero_guessing: 164 Zone affinity deviations preserved as historical locked v0.4.1 overrides; individual design approval provenance not independently determined
meta.score_reference_only: Function Score is exact Book1 number; not an extra multiplier in locked selection algorithm
meta.sync: Google Sheets and Drive JSON and GitHub JSON and Colab loader must all be updated together on user save/update.

experimental_neutral_and_rank.status: EXPERIMENTAL, NOT LOCKED, NOT USED IN GENERATOR v0.4.2
experimental_neutral_and_rank.place_faction_matrix: For EACH generated world, for each of the six final Factions, for every selected Zone and Location: A=(Type1+Type2+Base)/3; G=cuberoot(Type1*Type2*Base); Affinity=(A+G)/2, without random. Single-Type factions repeat Type1 as Type2.
experimental_neutral_and_rank.neutral_candidate: RETIRED: former 0.75+0.25*FactionMax is opposite to user intent and was dynamic, not master database; see static_database_revision for corrected candidate

neutral_candidate_alternatives.multiplicative_geometric: sqrt(Visible*Accessible)*(0.75+0.25*MaxFactionAffinity/100) — current preferred experiment, hard zero if either visibility/accessibility zero

normalization_candidates.percentile: 100*(# lower + 0.5*(# ties - 1))/(N-1), computed independently per Zone row or Location column among generated available candidates
normalization_candidates.max_ratio: 100*Affinity / max(other candidate affinities) in own row/column; 0 if max=0

experimental_neutral_and_rank.initial_preference_direction: Zone→Location and Location→Zone each normalized against different option sets; raw affinities symmetric but normalized directional preferences differ.
experimental_neutral_and_rank.limitations: Force one Zone per Location ONLY as a diagnostic for comparing normalization; does NOT set standalone or City compatibility, and does not combine Faction alignment into placement. These topics remain parked.
experimental_neutral_and_rank.recommendation: STATIC DATABASE: review static_database_revision candidate; generator ranking candidates remain max-ratio and percentile; neither formula locked.

static_database_revision.status: EXPERIMENTAL, NO SOURCE BOOK1 CHANGED, NOT YET APPROVED
static_database_revision.scope: One static neutral_people affinity per 110 Place types, derived from the 13 Book1 Faction Type affinity columns, independently of world-generated 6 Factions
static_database_revision.place_faction_source: Book1 Place×13 Faction Type, Zone uses the documented historical v0.4.1 overlay to reproduce locked active data
static_database_revision.formula: Openness=25*sqrt(Visible_0to4*AccessibleOutsider_0to4); Pressure=.40*max(Type13)+.30*mean(top3(Type13))+.30*mean(all13(Type13)); Neutral=clip(Openness*(1-.55*Pressure/100)+ContextAdjustment,0,100); if Visible or Access is 0, Neutral=0
static_database_revision.semantic: Neutral People affinity ≠ population density, ≠ ownership, ≠ actual faction influence; 13 Faction-Type affinity values are potential compatibility proxies
static_database_revision.reasoning: The original dynamic formula that grew with world-Faction max is invalid for static DB and reversed against user intent. A pure inverse of MAX yielded average 9.22 and almost all public spaces near zero; softer inverse distinguishes faction breadth without obliterating public markets. Explicit limited context corrections prevent wilderness from out-ranking ordinary towns solely because of visible/access score.
static_database_revision.caveat: Faction affinity and actual realized influence differ; static database cannot know which world factions exist. Generator alignment will use the six generated factions as separate runtime data.

rows.context_rationale: Public interaction among strangers and unaffiliated traders
Worksite with risk and controlled access beyond external visibility
Public mixed social space for travelers and townsfolk
Natural caves are not generally public gathering places
Open fields, but less public circulation than a settlement
Often territorial, seasonal, and away from everyday civilian activity
Public commerce and encounters across affiliations
Extractive hinterland with controlled worksites and scattered populations
Funerary domain is more specialized than a general public quarter
Open terrain, but remote and sparsely settled; visibility is not population
